result.summary: Found 3 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one major layout truncation issue, one minor duplicate content issue, and one minor truncation issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off — both the image and the restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu...' are truncated at the right edge of the screen, giving an incomplete and broken appearance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container has proper padding/snap points and that partial cards are visually indicated as scrollable (e.g., show ~20-30% of the next card) in a controlled and intentional way, or add a visible scroll affordance.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' restaurant cards with the same delivery time (15-25 min) and the same delivery price (€0.90), suggesting duplicate data or a rendering/data fetch issue.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source to ensure distinct restaurant entries are being returned and rendered. If these are two different branches, differentiate them with branch names or addresses.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off at the bottom of the screen with no visible restaurant name or details, making it unclear if it is a scrollable item or broken content.
issues.suggestion: This is likely intentional scroll affordance, but ensure at least the restaurant name is partially visible to give users context about what they will see upon scrolling.
